summary:
NIKE最新季度每股盈餘大幅超預期，達0.72美元，儘管營收微幅年減，但獲利能力展現強韌復甦。
• 每股盈餘（EPS）為0.72美元，大幅超越市場預期的0.13美元。
• 整體營收為109.7億美元，年減1.13%，符合營運調整期的預期。
• 成本控制與毛利率改善顯著，帶動獲利表現優於預期。
• 本益比處於17.55倍，評價面具備防守與修復空間。
ai_view:
觀點：本季財報顯示獲利能力改善優於營收表現，釋出營運轉型見效的訊號。短中期內，獲利優於預期有利於股價止穩回升；後續應追蹤庫存去化速度、毛利率變化及新產品線的市場接受度。

需留意：全球消費需求放緩可能持續壓抑營收成長動能。；庫存水準與促銷折扣壓力仍需持續觀察。

summary_en:
NIKE reported a significant EPS beat at $0.72 despite a slight revenue decline, demonstrating resilient profit recovery.
• EPS came in at $0.72, significantly beating the estimated $0.13.
• Total revenue was $10.97B, down 1.13% YoY, aligning with operational transition expectations.
• Cost controls and margin improvements drove stronger-than-expected profitability.
• Trailing P/E ratio stands at 17.55, offering a reasonable valuation for recovery.

view: The quarter shows better-than-expected profit improvements over revenue, signaling that operational turnaround efforts are taking effect. For the near to mid-term, the profit beat helps stabilize the stock. Key metrics to track include inventory liquidation speed, gross margin trends, and market acceptance of new product lines.

Watch：Global consumer demand slowdown may continue to suppress top-line growth.; Inventory levels and promotional discount pressures require ongoing monitoring.
